schema_transition.evidence: Reviewed single-step transition from the installed through-022 lineage (022 applied 2026-10-31, apply run 41180459540) to through-023, preserving installed order and byte hashes under the exact-prefix gate. Pending set: [023]. Owner-run read-only diagnosis on 2026-11-01 found V3 autocomplete scanning 198,523,840 canonical systems without a name index and timing out after 15 s; the derived Search default-opclass lower(name) btree cannot support LIKE prefixes under en_US.utf8. 023 adds only system_search_name_prefix on v3_derived.system_search (derived_generation_id, lower(name) text_pattern_ops), retaining system_search_name_lower and every payload row. The non-concurrent build permits reads, blocks derived writes, and owns BEGIN/COMMIT with its ledger row committed atomically; lock_timeout is 5 s and statement_timeout is 4 h. Only this migration receives the 245-minute command envelope; the apply job is bounded at 270 minutes. Capacity/time values in the runbook are planning estimates, not a production benchmark. scripts/operator/v3_schema_identity.py reproduces installed checksum c58e73a572dc24bb920c3cc595089460ccaaa44024de07ea3a73bdff87fe891f and target checksum f6a1d3bbd5b830eeac7363f0c6f51090329b2cb797c6f01beb472237938c5829 with migration-set identity sha256:9999dbe691edfed5406977f670d3768a27997d9991c116ccc104f6f1265ba623. The accepted 293bc72b release and its rollback targets remain compatible with both endpoints: this additive index changes no columns, views, functions, grants, ranking or payload. Registration only: exact-head acceptance, a reviewed governed plan listing pending exactly [023], and a separate apply remain required.
